name: @pm/htmx
description: The htmx variant (editorial-build slice E): hypermedia — server-rendered HTML from a hand-written Worker, the pinned htmx.org runtime vendored into the variant's own assets and served same-origin. REQUEST-TIME — trays are fetched through the edge Worker per request via this Worker's own pm-edge service binding (ADR-0002 §7); serves /htmx/* through the composed origin.
